bridges.description: Show that morally troubling violent passages can be acknowledged and interpreted within a reasonable belief that the Bible mediates divine revelation.
Ground interpretation of diverse biblical genres in the disclosed center of Jesus and the norm of increasing love of God and neighbor.
Defend reasonable religious belief without certainty by challenging an overly restrictive public-verification requirement.
Argue that biblical depictions of divine violence and judgment conflict with a morally perfect revealer and make belief in divine revelation unreasonable.
Require religious claims to be supported by objectively verifiable facts that indicate or uniquely fit the proposed explanation.
Argue that factual failures and divergent theological readings undermine treating the Bible as a clear, reliable revelation.
